senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂכַל; cmp. סָכָה)to be bright.
to look at, observe; to reflect, keep in mind.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 92a:20">Snh. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>המִסְתַּכֵּל בערוה</he> he who looks at his nakedness; (oth. opin.: who allows his obscene thoughts to dwell on a woman forbidden to him).
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ בכוכבים וכ׳</he> he looked at the stars and planets and recited a song.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:19">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ ביום המיתה</he> he speculated on the day of death.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 32:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 15:24">Prov. XV, 24</cite>) <he>מי שהוא מסתכל למעלה</he> he who looks on high (prays to God); <he>בניו … שנִסְתַּכְּלוּ וכ׳</he> the sons of Korah who looked on high escaped.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 41:2">Ps. XLI, 2</cite>) <he>אשרי נותן … הוי מסתכל בו וכ׳</he> it does not say, ‘blessed who gives to the poor’, but, ‘blessed who looks at the poor’, speculates how to do him good; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="U01158"><he>שָׂכַל</he></cite>.
